name: NHS & respiratory
summary: Flu, COVID and RSV at low or baseline levels; flu usually rises in November
state: UKHSA's 29 Oct update (week 43) showed flu stable at low levels (6.6% positivity), COVID low and falling (8.3%), and RSV rising but at baseline. UKHSA notes flu usually picks up in November; the next update is due 5 Nov. Resident doctors in England strike from 14 to 19 Nov.
for_you: If eligible, get your flu and COVID vaccines before winter. Use NHS 111 for urgent but non-emergency care.
rubric_hit: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.

sources.title: GOV.UK — Latest UKHSA weekly winter virus surveillance data

why: Winter respiratory waves and NHS capacity directly affect access to care for everyone in the UK.
drivers: Flu, COVID, RSV, norovirus, staffing, strikes.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
rubric.watch: Respiratory activity above baseline and rising, or several trusts in critical incidents.
rubric.normal: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.
